note: Runner: service/test/reporting.test.ts. Runners are ordinary risk; this file is the truth. SPEC-0002's frozen case D-005 also binds the emitted report and is not restated here.

cases.description: A held report matches the documented pumasi-report/1 schema exactly: no undocumented key at any level, and every documented key present.

steps.assert: the key set of $r, $r.platform, $r.config_shape and $r.health equals the schema's key set exactly

cases.description: No configuration value, secret, or person-derived datum survives into either tier. Built against a config populated with distinctive sentinel values in every string field.

steps.assert: no sentinel string (smtp url, oauth ids/secrets, token key, github token, zoom credentials, base url host, mail-from address) appears anywhere in the serialised payloads
config_shape contains only booleans and the documented enums

cases.description: Opt-out stops egress, observed at the transport. With PUMASI_REPORTING=false, the reporting tick performs zero network calls.

steps.assert: $net2 records exactly one POST to the configured report URL

cases.description: Behaviour parity: representative surfaces (home page, booking page, booking creation) return identical results with reporting on and off.

steps.assert: $a equals $b after removing nondeterministic fields (ids, tokens, timestamps)

cases.description: The printed payload is byte-identical to the sent body.
The start-up notice exists in both states and names the opt-out verbatim.

steps.assert: $on states reporting is on and contains the literal 'PUMASI_REPORTING=false'
$off states reporting is off and that nothing is sent

cases.description: A failed send is logged and dropped: the tick resolves without throwing, nothing is queued, and the next tick sends a fresh report rather than a backlog.

steps.assert: $t resolved without throwing and recorded one failed attempt

cases.description: A published report is signed or not sent; unsigned sending refuses without transmitting.

steps.assert: $u refused, and the transport recorded zero calls
$s sent one report whose signature.sponsor == 'example-sponsor' and whose conformance counts match .build/conformance.json

cases.description: The retention schedule is published: the privacy page states the twelve-month held retention, the deletion route, and — truthfully per path — that the live Cloudflare deployment still sends nothing.

steps.assert: the privacy document states a twelve-month retention for operating reports and a deletion-on-request route
the privacy document no longer claims the mechanism is unbuilt, and still states that this deployment sends nothing

cases.description: The Workers path has no reporting egress: the worker module neither imports the sender nor wires the tick.

steps.assert: the built worker entry contains no reference to the reporting sender
